validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE name = 'numa_alloc'

validation_queries.description: The numa_alloc region carries a size trace-arg of 4096
validation_queries.error_message: Expected the numa_alloc region to record a 'size' trace-arg equal to 4096.
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region_args A INNER JOIN regions R ON R.id = A.id AND R.guid = A.guid WHERE R.name = 'numa_alloc' AND A.name = 'size' AND A.value = '4096'
